name: Danganronpa: Lapse
source:
10 students find themselves trapped in a luxurious mansion and soon discover there is only one requirement for escape- to kill each other.
Follow the story through the student Echo Pine’s eyes as you unravel the secrets of the luxurious mansion, as well as the secrets of your fellow students…

[From the [url=https://www.mythridate.art/game-dev/danganronpalapse]developer's website[/url]]
